in_arabic.name: Aran
in_arabic.long_meaning: Aran هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. The name Aran is derived from the Arabic root 'R-N-N', which means 'mountain'. In Islamic context, it symbolizes the firmness and stability of faith. It is also mentioned in the Quran (31:10) as a metaphor for steadfastness.
